Prior hands-on experience working with UCPath, Kuali Financial System (KFS), and ServiceNow ticketing workflows.
Previous experience supporting finance, accounting, or payroll operations within a higher education or healthcare environment.
Coordinate, track, and follow up on payroll-related requests via ServiceNow tickets, including salary adjustments, funding changes, payroll discrepancies, and overpayments or underpayments.
Review salary worksheets, payroll ledgers, and faculty leave documentation for completeness and accuracy while maintaining internal tracking logs.
Process departmental reimbursements through the Kuali Financial System (KFS) and assist with Health Sciences (HS) account and badge requests.
Provide general administrative backup, data entry, reporting, and special project support across the Central Finance Operations team.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite—particularly Excel, Outlook, and Word—for data tracking, reporting, and correspondence.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the proven ability to review financial and payroll documentation for accuracy and completeness.
Familiarity with university academic personnel processes, faculty leave tracking, and departmental payroll procedures.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, paired with the ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize competing deadlines, and work both independently and collaboratively.
Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and maintain strict confidentiality when handling sensitive payroll and employee personnel information.
